id: title:Gilbert09:attach source schema context to person property sync failures

review.posthog_relevance: Preserves warehouse and schema identifiers in exception ingestion, supporting diagnostic differentiation and alerting.
review.reason: The hunk P1.F1.H1 explicitly passes warehouse and schema identifiers into the exception capture. This preserves diagnostic context, allowing PostHog support and alerting systems to distinguish warehouse-specific failures rather than treating them as generic exceptions. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and diagnostics.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the preservation of diagnostic context, but the actual operational benefit (e.g., reduced support ticket volume, faster incident resolution) is not demonstrated by the code or observations. No tests or rollback checks are cited. The score does not account for unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: The production activity now passes the activity inputs object to capture_exception, while the test asserts that the exception handler receives this context.
observations.posthog_connection: This change preserves diagnostic context (source and schema identifiers) in PostHog's error ingestion when warehouse person-property syncs fail, allowing support and alerting to distinguish failures by warehouse and schema rather than treating them as generic exceptions.
